entries.title: Psalms 10:3
segments: Blesseth the covetous--abhorreth; or, blesseth the covetous, [and] abhorreth the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 10:4
segments: God is not; the wicked feel and act as if there were no God.
Pride leads the wicked to forsake God, and to act as if he had no existence, and as if no one would ever call them to an account for their sins.

entries.title: Psalms 10:5
segments: Far above out of his sight; he has no faith in God's word, and because he sees not His threatened judgments, which are reserved in heaven against the appointed time, he utterly disregards them.

entries.title: Psalms 10:10
segments:
He croucheth, and humbleth himself; like a lion preparing to spring on his prey.  But many render, "He [the poor man] is crushed, he sinketh down; and the poor fall." 
 
  By his strong ones; probably, by his strong limbs or jaws, the enemy being compared to a lurking lion.

entries.title: Psalms 10:12
segments: God is perfectly acquainted with the doings both of the righteous and the wicked, and in due time will appear and render to all according to their words.

entries.title: Psalms 10:15
segments: Till thou find none; that remains unpunished.
